title: 第一卷 第10章 一不小心有了肌肤之亲！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

早饭过后，村长陈老栓亲自赶着马车来了。

“老林，王婆子两口子都招了，柳家丢的东西也是他俩干的。”陈老栓跳下车，拍拍林骁肩膀，“下午我就派人押他们去县衙。”

“辛苦你了，老陈。”林骁笑道。

“咱老哥俩客气啥？”陈老栓摆手。

“等我从县城回来，买酒，咱哥俩好好喝一顿。”

“成！那我等着！”

送走村长，林骁将半扇猪肉搬上马车，用草席盖严实。

上官飞燕早等在车边，眼睛亮晶晶的。

“走了。”林骁扬鞭。

马车驶出村子，上官飞燕坐在车沿，晃着腿，看着路旁雪景，忽然道：“老头，到城里我能喝碗鸭血粉丝汤不？”

“叫老头可不行。”林骁头也不回。

上官飞燕翻了个白眼：“林伯……”

“这还差不多。”

马车在雪路上吱呀前行。

走了一个多时辰，上官飞燕忽然皱起眉，捂着肚子。

起初她忍着没说，可疼痛越来越烈，额角渗出细汗。

“怎么了？”林骁察觉不对。

“肚子疼……有点内急。”上官飞燕声音发虚，“能停一下吗？”

林骁勒住马。

四周白雪皑皑，空无一人。

他朝路边枯草丛努努嘴：“去那边解决，我等你。”

上官飞燕跳下车，走几步又回头：“你、你可别丢下我跑了！”

“不会。”林骁失笑。

上官飞燕这才放心，小跑到一块大石后，蹲下身。

半炷香过去，人还没回来。

“还没好？”林骁扬声问。

“早上水晶脍吃多了……马上！”上官飞燕声音从石后传来。

又过了一会儿，她忽然僵住——没带手纸。

四下白茫茫一片，连片树叶都没有。

情急之下，她一咬牙，脱下一只棉袜，草草擦了，将袜子远远扔进雪堆。

正要提裤子，石缝里忽然窜出一道黑影。

“啊——！”

凄厉的惨叫划破雪野。

林骁脸色一变，跳下车冲过去。

他以为是遇了狼，可跑到大石后，只见上官飞燕瘫在雪地里，裤子褪到膝下，两条腿在雪光中白得晃眼。

“怎么了？”

“蛇……有蛇咬我……”上官飞燕脸色惨白，指着大腿。

林骁心一沉。

这山里毒蛇不少，冬天虽少动，但若被冬眠初醒的蛇咬，毒性最烈。

他低头看去，她大腿内侧果然有一排牙印。

林骁见状，松了口气，像这种成排的咬痕，大概率是无毒蛇。

Page (1/3)

After breakfast, the village chief Chen Laoshuan drove the carriage in person.

"Old Lin, Mrs. Wang and Mrs. Wang were both involved. They were also responsible for the things thrown away by the Liu family." Chen Laoshuan jumped out of the car and patted Lin Xiao on the shoulder, "I will send someone to escort them to the county government office in the afternoon."

"Thank you for your hard work, Lao Chen." Lin Xiao smiled.

"Why are we two so polite?" Chen Laoshuan waved his hand.

"When I come back from the county town, I'll buy some wine and let us have a good drink."

"Sure! Then I'll wait!"

After seeing off the village chief, Lin Xiao loaded half a fan of pork onto the carriage and covered it tightly with a straw mat.

Shangguan Feiyan had been waiting by the car for a long time, with bright eyes.

"Let's go." Lin Xiao raised his whip.

As the carriage drove out of the village, Shangguan Feiyan sat on the edge of the carriage, swinging her legs, looking at the snowy scenery on the roadside, and suddenly said: "Old man, can I have a bowl of duck blood and vermicelli soup when I get to the city?"

"You can't call me old man." Lin Xiao didn't even look back.

Shangguan Feiyan rolled his eyes: "Uncle Lin..."

"That's pretty much it."

The carriage creaked forward on the snowy road.

After walking for more than an hour, Shangguan Feiyan suddenly frowned and held his stomach.

At first she held back and didn't say anything, but the pain became more and more intense, and sweat broke out on her forehead.

"What's wrong?" Lin Xiao noticed something was wrong.

"My stomach hurts... I'm a little anxious." Shangguan Feiyan's voice was weak, "Can you stop for a moment?"

Lin Xiao reined in his horse.

There was snow all around and there was no one around.

He pursed his lips toward the dead grass on the roadside and said, "Go over there and deal with it. I'll wait for you."

Shangguan Feiyan jumped out of the car, walked a few steps and then turned back: "You, don't leave me and run away!"

"No." Lin Xiao laughed.

Shangguan Feiyan felt relieved now and trotted behind a big rock and squatted down.

Half the stick of incense has passed, but the person has not returned yet.

"Not yet?" Lin Xiao asked loudly.

"I ate too much crystal clams this morning... now!" Shangguan Feiyan's voice came from behind the stone.

After a while, she suddenly froze - she didn't bring toilet paper.

There was a vast expanse of white everywhere, not even a leaf.

In desperation, she gritted her teeth, took off a cotton sock, wiped it hastily, and threw the sock far into the snowdrift.

Just as he was about to lift his pants, a dark shadow suddenly emerged from the cracks in the stone.

"Ah——!"

The shrill screams pierced the snowy field.

Lin Xiao's expression changed, he jumped out of the car and rushed over.

He thought he had encountered a wolf, but when he ran behind the boulder, he saw Shangguan Feiyan paralyzed in the snow, his pants down to his knees, and his legs were dazzlingly white in the snow light.

"What's wrong?"

"Snake... a snake bit me..." Shangguan Feiyan turned pale and pointed at her thigh.

Lin Xiao's heart sank.

There are many venomous snakes in this mountain. Although they rarely move in winter, if you are bitten by a snake that has just woken up from hibernation, it will be the most poisonous.

He looked down and saw that there were indeed a row of teeth marks on her inner thigh.

Lin Xiao breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this. Rows of bite marks like this were most likely from non-venomous snakes.
